introduction: Nevada assesses Medicaid and Nevada Check Up through its medical-assistance application. Start with Access Nevada and review the decision for each person applying.
description: Nevada assesses Medicaid and Nevada Check Up through its medical-assistance application. Start with Access Nevada and review the decision for each person applying.

sections.who: Medicaid has several coverage categories, including children, families, adults and aged, blind or disabled applicants. Nevada Check Up serves eligible uninsured children through age 18 who are not covered by Medicaid or private insurance.
sections.get: Approved coverage pays for qualifying health services. Fees, coverage dates and plan arrangements depend on the program and the individual determination.

sections.apply:
1. Apply through Access Nevada

    Use Access Nevada; the pre-screen is a preliminary guide rather than an approval.

  2. Use the paper route if needed

    The medical-assistance application instructions also list a paper health-insurance application and its mailing instructions.

  3. Read individual decisions

    Respond to verification requests and check the coverage outcome and enrollment directions for each applicant.
sections.after: Keep mailing, phone and email details updated with DSS. Ask the agency about an unclear decision or renewal request rather than assuming the whole household has the same coverage.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using State medical-assistance application guidance, Nevada Medicaid and Check Up overview, Application and decision process. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is Nevada Check Up the same as Medicaid?
It is a separate low-cost coverage program for qualifying uninsured children.
Does the screening tool approve coverage?
No. Continue with the application for an eligibility determination.
Is the provider-enrollment website where I apply?
No. Residents apply through Access Nevada or the state’s listed application alternatives.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
